label: desktop-interactions-settled
invocation: async (page) => { const checks={}; const a=page.locator(".ai-extension-accordion"), s=a.locator("summary"), b=page.locator(".critique button").first(); if(await a.evaluate(el=>el.open))await s.click(); await b.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded(); await b.hover(); const settled=()=>page.waitForFunction(()=>Number(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(".critique-popover")).opacity)>0.99); await settled(); checks.pointerCritique=true; await page.screenshot({path:"output/playwright/standalone-debate-v1/debate-261/desktop-critique-settled.png"}); await page.mouse.move(0,0); await b.focus(); await page.keyboard.press("Enter"); await settled(); checks.critiqueEnter=true; await page.keyboard.press("Space"); await settled(); checks.critiqueSpace=true; checks.aiInitiallyCollapsed=await a.evaluate(el=>!el.open); await s.click(); checks.aiPointerOpened=await a.evaluate(el=>el.open); await page.keyboard.press("Enter"); checks.aiEnterClosed=await a.evaluate(el=>!el.open); await page.keyboard.press("Space"); checks.aiSpaceOpened=await a.evaluate(el=>el.open); await s.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded(); if(Object.values(checks).some(v=>v!==true))throw new Error(JSON.stringify(checks)); return checks; }
